{{Quote|Hey, bounty hunters, stop monopolizing all the transmitters.|The bartender droid to a group of bounty hunters|<ref name="Revenge (episode)">{{TCW|Revenge (episode)}}</ref>}}
A '''BU-series droid bartender''' was working as a [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]] at [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], this droid was serving drinks at the bar when several [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]], including former [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolyte]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]], were looking at a [[Transmitter/Legends|transmitters]] for the latest [[Bounty/Legends|bounties]].
